adaptations: Range.cs is byte-for-byte the second external agent exercise source.
Switchback.csproj replaces the machine-specific SDK hint with ../reference/Poima.Gameplay.dll; explicitly selects Range.cs and preserves the Switchback assembly name and language/runtime properties.

world.json preserves world identity, revision 5, all 82 entities, all 11 UI controls, components and references; authoring receipts and empty retired-ID arrays are reset to empty arrays, then pretty-printed.
range.poima-input.json preserves the original profile bytes, revision 1 and its required committed receipt. The receipt contains no machine-specific paths.

project.json preserves project identity, name, entry, input profile and audio; version 1 omits the absent native gameplay artifact until the documented publish/adopt operation installs a verified version-2 selection.
exercise.json selects portable roles, semantic fields, UI identities and inspected imported rig binding from the second game handoff, plus SaveStatus completion value 3.
Only the three actively referenced cooked assets and their three CC0 provenance records are copied. Original character and interface sound notices are copied byte-for-byte.
